scope: Legacy CSV sensor ingestion and demo ClickHouse error reporting

behavior.clickhouse_fallback: The direct demo/maintenance ClickHouse fallback logs only the exception class; canonical transaction-backed projection errors still propagate.
behavior.invalid_timestamp: Raw parser text is replaced with a fixed message in warnings and ingestion audit fields.
behavior.invalid_numeric_value: CSV numeric parse warnings no longer echo the raw cell value.
behavior.row_failure: Row-processing failures use a fixed audit summary plus exception class; rollback behavior is preserved.

coverage: secret-bearing ClickHouse failure is absent from logs
invalid timestamp input is absent from warning and audit fields
invalid numeric CSV value is absent from warnings
secret-bearing row-processing exception is absent from log and audit while rollback and cleanup remain

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; synthetic CSV and mocked connections/providers

limitations: No live sensor source, database, ClickHouse service, or provider was contacted.
This does not establish sensor source parity, live runtime recovery, or tenant acceptance.
